executiveSummary.headline: Resolve Conflicting Event Facts and Clarify the Official Domain
executiveSummary.lead: Waterstone appears in 76.6% of eligible scenarios and earns 53.5% consideration, but ranks fifth among six Hilton Honors peers. That is useful mid-level coverage, not a leading portfolio position.
executiveSummary.leadSupport: The most urgent work is factual and operational: establish one official domain and one approved meeting-space total.
executiveSummary.metricsNote: These metrics describe presence in monitored AI answers—not bookings, revenue, or traveler exposure.

themes.title: Meeting-Space Claims Conflict
themes.what: Hilton states more than 7,500 square feet of flexible meeting space and a ballroom for up to 225, while waterstoneboca.com states 18,899 square feet.
themes.whyItMatters: This material public discrepancy requires hotel confirmation and clear counting definitions before either figure is promoted, corrected, or distributed to partners.

themes.title: Two Domains Create Avoidable Uncertainty
themes.what: The ADP-listed waterstoneresort.com repeatedly timed out or returned 504/status 0 in research probes, while waterstoneboca.com served active rooms, dining, and meetings content.
themes.whyItMatters: Management should document the intended canonical domain, redirects, ownership, booking-path behavior, and partner references before approving any public-facing technical or content changes externally.

themes.title: The Active Site Has Strong Commercial Building Blocks
themes.what: The working site presents rooms, SeaSpray and Kasumi dining, and meeting content; Hilton provides an additional trusted property profile.
themes.whyItMatters: Once facts and domain control are settled, the agency can align waterfront, dining, and events information across trusted guest-facing digital channels without inventing a new proposition.

priorities.action: Confirm the meeting-space source of truth
Align active-site and Hilton property facts
priorities.desiredOutcome: Consistent rooms, dining, and meetings details

executiveSummary.successLooksLike: The hotel has signed meeting facts, a documented canonical-domain decision, working redirects where approved, and consistent Hilton and active-site information.
executiveSummary.closing: Executive Takeaway: Waterstone already has credible scenario coverage, but its fifth-place peer position and public fact conflicts leave room for improvement. Resolve the 7,500-versus-18,899-square-foot discrepancy and domain ownership path before investing in broader messaging.

actions.headline: Establish One Approved Meeting-Space Source of Truth
actions.priorityWhy: Two trusted guest-facing sources publish materially different meeting-space totals.
actions.whatWeFound: Hilton says the resort offers over 7,500 square feet of flexible meeting space and a ballroom for up to 225; waterstoneboca.com claims 18,899 square feet of space.
actions.whyItMatters: Planners need comparable definitions and accurate capacities. The difference may reflect scope or counting conventions, but that must be confirmed by the hotel before corrections.
recommendedSteps: Events leadership defines total indoor, outdoor, flexible, and ballroom space.
Document whether each published number uses a different scope.
Submit precise corrections to Hilton and/or the active site.
actions.supportingParties: Hotel GM; Hilton content support; digital agency
actions.suggestedTimeframe: Confirmation in 1 week; corrections within 30 days
actions.timeframeNote: Timing is proposed and requires accountable-owner agreement.

completionCriteria.investigationCompleted: A signed space inventory defines every component and reconciles 7,500+ and 18,899 square feet.
completionCriteria.correctionSubmitted: Field-level correction requests are filed for each source that does not match the signed definitions.
completionCriteria.correctionVerifiedLive: Hilton and the active meetings page use approved figures and clearly distinguish indoor, outdoor, total, and ballroom capacities.
completionCriteria.noChangeRequired: Valid only if both figures are accurate under clearly disclosed definitions and the hotel documents why no correction is needed.

actions.hotelApprovalNotes: Events leadership must confirm counting definitions and capacities before any public correction.

changesOrInvestigation: Inventory every event space and counting rule.
Reconcile gross, usable, indoor, outdoor, and flexible totals.
Update exact fields and copy only after sign-off.

evidence.label: Active hotel meetings page — 18,899 square feet
Hilton Curio property page — 7,500+ square feet and ballroom up to 225

technicalDetails.verificationMethod: Signed event-space schedule compared with both live URLs; archive correction tickets and screenshots.
dependencies: Events leadership must confirm counting definitions and capacities before any public correction.
technicalDetails.notes: No paid research or ADP remeasurement was performed.

actions.headline: Resolve Official-Domain and Redirect Consistency
actions.priorityWhy: The ADP-listed domain repeatedly failed in research while a different branded domain served active hotel content.
actions.whatWeFound: waterstoneresort.com repeatedly returned timeouts, 504, or status 0 in bounded probes. waterstoneboca.com was readable and carried active rooms, dining, and meetings content.
actions.whyItMatters: A clear canonical-domain decision helps guests, partners, and automated systems identify the hotel’s current official source. Probe failures alone do not establish a universal outage.
recommendedSteps: Confirm ownership and intended role of both domains.
Review DNS, TLS, hosting, redirects, canonical tags, and partner links.
Implement and verify redirects only if approved.
actions.supportingParties: Domain registrar; hosting provider; digital agency; Hilton content support
actions.suggestedTimeframe: Decision within 2 weeks; approved remediation within 30 days
actions.timeframeNote: Timing is proposed and requires accountable-owner agreement.

completionCriteria.investigationCompleted: A domain-control memo records ownership, intended use, DNS/hosting state, redirect behavior, and canonical choice.
completionCriteria.correctionSubmitted: Approved DNS, redirect, canonical-tag, or partner-link tickets are filed with owners and rollback plans.
completionCriteria.correctionVerifiedLive: Both domains behave as approved across browser and monitored clients, and official profiles point to the chosen domain.
completionCriteria.noChangeRequired: Valid if management documents that both domains intentionally serve distinct purposes and no failed guest path remains; rationale is filed.

actions.hotelApprovalNotes: Hotel leadership must approve the canonical domain and any DNS or redirect change.

supportingEvidence.label: Bounded technical probes
supportingEvidence.note: Repeated timeout/504/status 0 observations for waterstoneresort.com; not proof of universal outage.

changesOrInvestigation: Confirm registrant and account control for both domains.
Record DNS, TLS, HTTP, redirect, and canonical behavior.
Audit Hilton and priority links for the intended destination.
Do not retire or redirect a domain without ownership and booking-path review.

evidence.label: Bounded technical probes
evidence.note: Repeated timeout/504/status 0 observations for waterstoneresort.com; not proof of universal outage.

technicalDetails.verificationMethod: Domain-control memo plus multi-environment HTTP/redirect checks and live partner-link audit.
dependencies: Hotel leadership must approve the canonical domain and any DNS or redirect change.
technicalDetails.notes: Treat the failure pattern as a high-priority investigation, not proof that the site is universally down.

actions.headline: Align Waterfront, Dining, and Meetings Facts Across Active Sources
actions.priorityWhy: The active site and Hilton profile are both important sources once domain and event facts are settled.
actions.whatWeFound: waterstoneboca.com presents rooms, SeaSpray and Kasumi dining, and meetings content; Hilton presents the Curio property profile. Their stable facts should be compared after the event-space source of truth is approved.
actions.whyItMatters: Consistent outlet names, waterfront language, event definitions, and inquiry routes make the resort easier to assess without overstating what content changes will achieve.
recommendedSteps: Create a stable-facts inventory from operations.
Compare active rooms, dining, meetings, and Hilton pages.
Assign owners for volatile hours and offer details.

actions.suggestedTimeframe: Audit within 30 days after AVA-WBR-001 and 002 decisions

methodology.scope: Combines the certified ADP baseline with a bounded review of named public pages and zero-cost technical probes. No paid research, Airtable write, ADP remeasurement, or customer publication was performed.
claimTypeGuide: VERIFIED_ISSUE — a directly observed, source-backed discrepancy.
RECOMMENDED_INVESTIGATION — evidence warrants review but does not prove a defect or cause.
REQUIRES_HOTEL_CONFIRMATION — hotel leadership must establish the source of truth before correction.
OPTIONAL_COMMERCIAL_OPPORTUNITY — proceed only if leadership wants the demand.
responsibilities: Hotel leadership confirms facts, priorities, and public changes.
Digital or brand teams implement only approved corrections and document verification.
Dealality packages measurement context and evidence without implying booking or revenue causation.
methodology.monthlyReviewRelationship: Approved actions may be tracked in a later review. Completing an action does not itself prove a change in AI presence, bookings, or revenue.
methodology.nextStep: Confirm the decision items, then authorize the highest-priority validated work.
